race.comment: BEATTY (1) has been very impressive this time in, bolting in to win the Fairetha as a hot favourite. ROGER was a late scratching there and he does draw wide here, but he's hard to knock on what he's done throughout his career. Can fly over the top and keep the winning streak alive. ROGER (3) didn't get the face BEATTY in the Fairetha, saving the mouth-watering match-up for today. He's missed that run which is a niggle, though the mile is a big tick and he maps to have the tactical advantage. He looks the main danger. TREASURED LEGACY (11) gets the blinkers on again today on the quick turnaround off the Champion Fillies. A better draw suits this time and she can be in the finish. DIXIE DOO (10) flew late in the Champion Fillies last week and was the clear eye catcher there. Can feature again. GODSPEED (4) won't be far away.
